_comment: Synthetic golden set (10 cases) for evals/scorers/mapping_scorer.py. Each case pairs one obligation with a small candidate-control pool (1 correct target + distractors) so retrieval+rerank ranking (Top-1/Top-3) can be scored, not just the final LLM classification. expected_gap_class is null when expected_coverage_level is 'full' and no gap is expected; otherwise it's the deterministic gap_class audit_agent.py would assign from that coverage_level (none -> no_control, partial -> partial_coverage).

candidate_controls.design_description: Incident response team escalates and reports major incidents to senior management and the competent authority within 12 hours of detection.

candidate_controls.design_description: Building security issues and revokes access badges for staff.

candidate_controls.design_description: Finance approves vendor invoices above a materiality threshold before payment.

candidate_controls.design_description: IT enforces 90-day password rotation for all employee accounts.

cases._note: Corrected 2026-09-28: was labelled 'partial'. A weekly-batch cadence is structurally incapable of ever meeting a 24-hour deadline (a ~7x mismatch, not a close miss) -- re-reviewed against GPT-5.1's own well-reasoned 'none' verdict (see BENCHMARK_REPORT.md's mapping-accuracy investigation) and the label was the one that was wrong, not the model.
